feature: IS KNOWN / IS UNKNOWN observation predicates — the field-observation convention's null axis as query vocabulary

scenarios.name: IS UNKNOWN returns only the unobserved (null observed_at) row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NULL on an unset value intent)

scenarios.name: IS KNOWN excludes the unobserved row (complement of IS UNKNOWN)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NOT NULL complement intent)

scenarios.name: IS UNKNOWN composes with AND on a second comparison
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (null predicate composed with a comparison intent)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at IS UNKNOWN AND n.data.severity_score = 0

scenarios.name: IS UNKNOWN keyword is case-insensitive — lowercase 'is unknown' is identical
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (keyword case folding: lowercase `is unknown` parses identically to `IS UNKNOWN`, mirroring the IS NOT NULL case-insensitivity already pinned)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at is unknown RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id
